tos.title: Terms of Service
tos.introText: Welcome to OpenDict. By accessing and using our services, you agree to comply with the terms and conditions outlined below. Please read carefully before using.
tos.acceptanceText: By registering an account, accessing, or using OpenDict, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our services.

tos.accountsItem1: Provide accurate, complete, and up-to-date information
tos.accountsItem2: Secure your login credentials and be responsible for all activities under your account
tos.accountsItem3: Notify us immediately if you detect unauthorized use of your account
tos.accountsItem4: Not share your account with others
tos.contentText: When contributing content (terms, definitions, comments) to OpenDict, you:
tos.contentItem1: Retain ownership of your content but grant OpenDict the right to use, modify, and distribute it
tos.contentItem2: Confirm that the content does not infringe third-party intellectual property rights
tos.contentItem3: Are responsible for the accuracy and legality of the content
tos.contentItem4: Agree that content may be moderated or removed if it violates regulations
tos.prohibitedItem1: Post content that is defamatory, offensive, pornographic, or violates the law
tos.prohibitedItem2: Use the service for unauthorized commercial purposes or spam
tos.prohibitedItem3: Interfere with system operations or gain unauthorized access
tos.prohibitedItem4: Collect information from other users without permission
tos.prohibitedItem5: Impersonate identity or origin of content
tos.ipText: All content, design, logos, and software of OpenDict are our property and protected by intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, or distribute without written permission.
tos.disclaimerText: OpenDict provides services 'as is' without any warranties. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of content. Use of the service is entirely at your own risk.
tos.liabilityText: OpenDict and its members are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the service.
tos.changesText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new effective date. Continued use of the service after changes means you accept the new terms.
tos.contactText: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us:

privacy.pageDescription: Privacy policy and personal data processing of OpenDict
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: OpenDict is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when using our services.
privacy.collectText: We collect the following types of information:
privacy.collectPersonalItem1: Name and email address when you register an account
privacy.collectPersonalItem2: Profile picture and profile information (if you provide it)
privacy.collectPersonalItem3: Authentication information via Google (if you log in with Google)
privacy.collectUsageItem1: Search history and terms you view
privacy.collectUsageItem3: IP address, browser type, operating system
privacy.useItem1: Provide, operate, and improve OpenDict services
privacy.useItem3: Send notifications about updates, security, and technical support
privacy.useItem4: Analyze usage trends and develop new features
privacy.useItem5: Prevent fraud and ensure system security
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell your personal information. Information is only shared in the following cases:
privacy.sharingItem2: With trusted service providers supporting OpenDict operations
privacy.sharingItem4: To protect the rights, property, or safety of OpenDict and users
privacy.securityText: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure.
privacy.cookiesText: OpenDict uses cookies to improve user experience, store preferences, and analyze traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect some features.
privacy.rightsItem1: Access and receive a copy of your personal data
privacy.rightsItem2: Request correction or update of inaccurate information
privacy.rightsItem3: Delete your account and data (subject to legal requirements)
privacy.rightsItem5: File a complaint with data protection authorities if you believe your rights have been violated
privacy.childrenText: OpenDict does not knowingly collect information from users under 13 years of age. If you discover that a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us to delete that information.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on this page. We encourage you to review the policy regularly.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact:

aboutPage.metaDescription: Learn about OpenDict, our mission, key features, and community values.
aboutPage.title: About OpenDict
aboutPage.subtitle: OpenDict is a multilingual open dictionary platform for Vietnamese, Lao, and English where the community contributes, reviews, and shares knowledge.
aboutPage.missionText: We built OpenDict to help everyone look up terms quickly, accurately, and accessibly, especially for learning and professional use.
aboutPage.visionText: To become a trusted open dictionary ecosystem for users in Vietnam and Laos by combining community collaboration with AI-powered support.
aboutPage.feature4: Favorites, search history, and profile management
aboutPage.communityText: Content on OpenDict is built through user contributions and moderation workflows to keep it useful, context-aware, and easy to understand.
aboutPage.contactText: If you would like to collaborate, send feedback, or report an issue, please contact the OpenDict team via email:
